title: WHO says fruit juice still counts as free sugars even when none were added
summary: The healthy-diet sheet says most fruit juices, including those without added sugars, contain significant free sugars.
body: The 26 January 2026 healthy-diet fact sheet says fresh fruit and vegetables are great choices, and that frozen and canned ones are also good if they do not have added sugars or excess sodium. It then says that while fruit juice can be consumed, most varieties, including those without added sugars, contain significant amounts of free sugars, and that consumption of free sugars should be limited. Juice is therefore not the same thing as eating the fruit, on this sheet. The sheet does not ban juice in a single sentence. It places juice with free sugars. Adult gram limits for fruit and vegetables are a different card.
